tasks.description: Create a data retention policy that deletes user activity data 30 days after collection. This policy should be enforced by an automated pipeline and apply to every user activity record without exception.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user activity record, when 30 days have passed since collection, then the record is deleted from the event store.

tasks.description: Develop an automated job that deletes user activity data older than 30 days from the event store. The job should run periodically to ensure compliance with the data retention policy.
acceptance_criteria: Given the automated deletion job, when it runs, then all user activity data older than 30 days is deleted from the event store.

tasks.description: Design and implement a data archiving solution that retains the complete historical event log for trend analysis. The solution should ensure that no activity events are deleted and the event log remains complete and available for querying.
acceptance_criteria: Given the data archiving solution, when querying the event log, then all historical event data is available and complete.

tasks.description: Implement access controls to restrict access to the event store to authorized personnel only. All access should be logged for auditing purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unauthorized user, when attempting to access the event store, then access is denied and the attempt is logged.

tasks.summary: Develop internal tools for querying event log
tasks.description: Create internal tools that allow authorized personnel to query the event log for trend analysis and other purposes. The tools should be user-friendly and provide relevant insights.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when using the internal tools to query the event log, then the user can retrieve relevant data and insights.

tasks.description: Develop a logging solution that tracks all access to the event store and stores the logs for auditing purposes. The logs should be secure and tamper-proof.
acceptance_criteria: Given an access attempt to the event store, when the attempt is logged, then the log is stored securely and is tamper-proof.

tasks.summary: Conduct internal audit and compliance review
tasks.description: Perform an internal audit and compliance review to ensure that the data retention policy is enforced consistently and stakeholders' needs are met. The review should verify that the system passes both internal audit and compliance review.
acceptance_criteria: Given the internal audit and compliance review, when the review is complete, then the system is compliant with all relevant regulations and stakeholders' needs are met.
